query: For my 62‑year‑old female: among females 57–67 with sepsis (without shock) versus septic shock, report in‑hospital mortality by LOS (≤7 vs >7 days) and Charlson (≤3/4–5/>5): mortality %, absolute and relative differences.
final_sql: SELECT (SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL AND p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dod) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 62 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.intime) BETWEEN 2017 AND 2018 AND a.los <= 7 AND d.charlson <= 5 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dod) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) -
